name: Koakuma Hatsuiku Chu~!
source:
The protagonist, Nakashimizu Hiro, goes back to his home when summer vacation begins. He is a university student who is seen as serious but well-liked by people around him. As a consequence, he's been trusted to teach as a private tutor for his cousin Hikaru and his childhood friend Rina, who actually have secret feeling for him. This also applies to his friend’s little sister Manami who often come to his house. His little sister Sana also respects him very much. Yet, he never dates any of them, or even had a girlfriend for once. The reason is that he actually has a secret he takes to the grave: he likes getting approached by assertive, younger girls.  

However, one day the girls find out about his fetish in an accident! And now all the girls who were previously meek become aggressive towards him, including his little sister!? 

What will happen to his life from now on…
translation:
暑假开始后，中清水博回到家乡。他是一名大学生，给人的印象认真可靠，很受周围人欢迎。因此，他被拜托担任表妹光和儿时好友莉奈的家庭教师，两人其实都暗恋着他。朋友的妹妹真奈也经常来他家。妹妹纱奈同样非常尊敬他。然而，他从未和她们中的任何人约会，甚至从没交过女朋友。原因是他隐藏着一个要带进坟墓的秘密：他喜欢被强势的年幼女孩主动接近。

某天，女孩们意外发现了他的癖好！原本温顺的女孩们全都开始对他变得主动，包括他的妹妹？！

今后的生活会变成什么样……
